title: Common
description: Definitions shared by more than one servtuner schema.

duration.description: A Go-style duration string such as "500ms", "120s" or "1m30s". The one duration representation used in every schema.

hopTransport.description: How one connection was secured: whether it used TLS, and whether servtuner presented a client certificate on it. Never inferred.

tls.description: The connection used TLS. False is plain HTTP or TCP.

client_cert.description: servtuner presented a client certificate on it. Always false without TLS.

utcTimestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC: a Z suffix, optional fractional seconds. The one timestamp representation used in every schema. Enforced by the pattern alone, with no format keyword, so every language checks it the same way.

scrapeIntervalSource.description: Where a scrape interval came from: read from Prometheus (/api/v1/targets) or assumed because Prometheus could not be asked.

bootstrapInterval.description: A non-negative statistic with its bootstrap confidence interval, in the unit of the property that holds it. Either value, ci_low and ci_high are all present, or they are all absent and insufficient_samples_reason says why (too few samples for the percentile); never both. ci_low <= value <= ci_high is not expressible here and is a servtuner analyze self-check.

samples.description: Observations the statistic was computed from.

insufficient_samples_reason.description: Present when value and the bounds are omitted because samples is too small.

metricName.description: A lowercase series name: letters, digits and underscores. Used for RunSpec extra queries and bundle series files.

catalogName.description: A Prometheus query catalog; extra is the RunSpec's extra_queries.

sloName.description: The SLO keys of the RunSpec's slos block.
